$comment: How the Factory reads this product's numbers: QuR Tag keeps its data in schema qurtag of the shared ImpactConsulting project behind its own data API (/api/data), so the Factory calls one counting function, qurtag.factory_metrics, with its metrics token (only the token's SHA-256 is kept, in qurtag.factory_access). It returns totals only: accounts, sign-ups and sign-ins, accounts with an item, items, working tags, scans, conversations, owner replies, and the support queue (Contact us requests plus open reports of finders' notes, as support_open, support_30d and support_oldest_open_days; the reports on their own as reports_open, reports_30d and reports_oldest_open_days). Defined in db/qurtag.sql. It also returns how many conversations the owner marked 'I have it back' (returned_total, returned_30d), Free households at and over the item limit, tag print and download actions with the count of households that printed and a total per style, scans in 30 days with and without a note and the share with none, sign-ups and activated accounts per channel for 7 and 30 days, paid members by plan and by where they pay (stripe or apple), and iPhone accounts with alerts on against all iPhone accounts. Defined in db/qurtag.sql and db/measures.sql.
